definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}, referring to female middle school students.

examples.english: I have a daughter in middle school.

examples.japanese: JC{向|む}けのアプリが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Apps targeting middle school girls are increasing.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}のJCはスマホを{持|も}つのが{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}だ。
examples.english: It's normal for middle school girls nowadays to have smartphones.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of {女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい} (female middle school student). J = {女子|じょし} (female), C = {中学生|ちゅうがくせい} (middle school student).

USAGE:
Used in:
・Marketing and media
・Internet and social media
・Casual conversation

RELATED TERMS:
・JK - {女子高生|じょしこうせい} (high school girl)
・JD - {女子大生|じょしだいせい} (female college student)
